panels.title: Decisions in range
panels.description: Every routing decision of the gateway in the range, from every listener (guardrail proxy and route-only). A decision is one request the router looked at.

targets.expr: sum((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range)))

panels.title: Routed (applied) share
panels.description: Share of decisions that sent the call to a routed model. The rest fell back to the original request or were refused.

targets.expr: sum((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="applied"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="applied"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="applied"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="applied"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="applied"} offset $__range))) / sum((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range)))

panels.title: Calls that fell back to the original
panels.description: Model calls that went to the original request after the routed model could not be used (model.usage logs with route decision fallback). It also counts fallbacks that happen after the decision, such as a routed model that refused the connection. 0 needs usage records to be on.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | host_name=~"$host" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | body_defenseclaw_route_decision="fallback" [$__range])) or 0 * sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | host_name=~"$host" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") [$__range])))

panels.title: Refused by routing (managed)
panels.description: Requests a managed routing.admin rule or budget refused. Only managed gateways refuse; an OSS gateway shows 0 here.

targets.expr: (sum((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="denied"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="denied"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="denied"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="denied"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="denied"} offset $__range))) or 0 * sum((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range))))

panels.title: Sensitive requests kept local
panels.description: Requests narrowed by routing.sensitive (a sensitive keyword or guardrail severity) that were routed to a local model.

targets.expr: (sum((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",filtered_by="sensitive",result="applied"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",filtered_by="sensitive",result="applied"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",filtered_by="sensitive",result="applied"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",filtered_by="sensitive",result="applied"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",filtered_by="sensitive",result="applied"} offset $__range))) or 0 * sum((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range))))

panels.title: Routing latency p95 (ms)
panels.description: 95th percentile of defenseclaw.semantic_routing.latency over the range: how long the router takes to decide. The metric has no connector label; the Host filter applies.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_latency_milliseconds_bucket{host_name=~"$host"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Decisions over time, by result
panels.description: Increase of defenseclaw.semantic_routing.decision per interval: applied, fallback, denied.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Decisions by reason (route source)
panels.description: What picked the route. rules = your keyword rules, systemone = the System One classifier, vllm_sr = the vLLM classifier, force = an administrator rule or a budget downgrade chose it, default = the default model, user_override = the model the person asked for was allowed, sticky = the conversation's earlier choice. No source = no model was chosen (fallback or refusal).

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (route_source) (increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval])), "route_source", "no source", "route_source", "^$")

panels.title: Decisions by listener
panels.description: route_only = hook connectors such as Codex and Claude Code through /r/<connector>; guardrail = the LLM proxy and passthrough paths.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (listener) (increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval])), "listener", "unreported", "listener", "^$")

panels.title: Top routed categories (range)
panels.description: The bounded category label the classifier gave the request, most frequent first. Calls with no category are listed as none.

targets.expr: topk(10, label_replace(sum by (route_category) ((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range))), "route_category", "none", "route_category", "^$"))

panels.title: Calls by routed model (logs)
panels.description: Model calls per interval by the model the gateway sent them to (defenseclaw.model.selected in model.usage logs). Absent model = the record carries none.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | host_name=~"$host" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | label_format model="{{if .body_defenseclaw_model_selected}}{{.body_defenseclaw_model_selected}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Calls by route decision (logs)
panels.description: applied = sent to the routed model, fallback = went to the original after a routing failure, passthrough = the route-only listener left the model unchanged, none = routing is off for the call.

targets.expr: sum by (decision) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | host_name=~"$host" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | label_format decision="{{if .body_defenseclaw_route_decision}}{{.body_defenseclaw_route_decision}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Decisions by connector (range)
panels.description: Decisions per connector over the range.

targets.expr: sum by (connector) ((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range)))

panels.title: Calls by routed model (range, logs)
panels.description: Model calls per model the gateway sent them to over the range (defenseclaw.model.selected in model.usage logs). Models the record does not name are listed as unreported.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | host_name=~"$host" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | label_format model="{{if .body_defenseclaw_model_selected}}{{.body_defenseclaw_model_selected}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" [$__range]))

panels.title: Fallbacks by cause (decisions)
panels.description: Why the router fell back at decision time, before any call: timeout, upstream_status, decode_failure, unknown_alias, credential_failure, configuration_failure, filtered, breaker_open, low_confidence, no_candidate.

targets.expr: sum by (error_code) (increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="fallback"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Calls that fell back, by cause (logs)
panels.description: From model.usage logs: calls whose routed model could not be used and that went to the original, by closed cause. Unlike the decision count, this includes fallbacks that happen after the decision (a refused connection, an upstream error). unreported = the record carries no cause.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | host_name=~"$host" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | body_defenseclaw_route_decision="fallback" | label_format reason="{{if .body_defenseclaw_route_fallback_reason}}{{.body_defenseclaw_route_fallback_reason}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Refusals by reason (managed)
panels.description: Requests a managed gateway refused, by closed reason: budget_exceeded, budget_unavailable, budget_cost_unknown, budget_downgrade_unavailable, rule_deny (an administrator deny rule), identity_unconfirmed, routing_admin_denied, routing_sensitive_local_unavailable; anything else is other.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (deny_reason) (increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result="denied"}[$__rate_interval])), "deny_reason", "unreported", "deny_reason", "^$")

panels.title: Sensitive requests refused (fail closed)
panels.description: Requests narrowed to a local model that no local model could serve, refused instead of sent to a cloud model. It has a value only once a gateway refuses such a request (GAP-0576); a gateway that does not yet fail closed never reports it, so an empty panel is not proof that none leaked. Read Sensitive requests that went to the original model for the requests that did.

targets.expr: sum((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",deny_reason="routing_sensitive_local_unavailable"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",deny_reason="routing_sensitive_local_unavailable"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",deny_reason="routing_sensitive_local_unavailable"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",deny_reason="routing_sensitive_local_unavailable"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",deny_reason="routing_sensitive_local_unavailable"} offset $__range)))

panels.title: Sensitive requests that went to the original model
panels.description: Requests narrowed by routing.sensitive for which no local model was usable, so the call fell back to the ORIGINAL (usually cloud) model. This is the leak path: a gateway that fails closed (GAP-0576) refuses these instead and counts them under Sensitive requests refused.

targets.expr: (sum((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",filtered_by="sensitive",result="fallback"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",filtered_by="sensitive",result="fallback"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",filtered_by="sensitive",result="fallback"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",filtered_by="sensitive",result="fallback"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",filtered_by="sensitive",result="fallback"} offset $__range))) or 0 * sum((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range))))

panels.title: Fallbacks and refusals by cause (range)
panels.description: One row per result, cause and listener over the range.

targets.expr: sum by (result, error_code, deny_reason, listener) ((((increase(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result=~"fallback|denied"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result=~"fallback|denied"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result=~"fallback|denied"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result=~"fallback|denied"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_semantic_routing_decision_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host",result=~"fallback|denied"} offset $__range)))

panels.title: Spent on compared calls (USD)
panels.description: Cost of the calls that have both their own cost and a price for the model the client asked for. Calls with an unpriced requested model are left out of both sides, so the comparison is like for like.

targets.expr: sum((((increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range)))

panels.title: The same calls on the requested model (USD)
panels.description: What the same calls would have cost if every one had gone to the model the client asked for (same token counts, your price table). This is the counterfactual of routing.

targets.expr: sum((((increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range)))

panels.title: Saved (USD)
panels.description: Counterfactual minus spent. Negative (red) means routing cost more than the requested model would have, for example a hard question sent to a stronger model.

targets.expr: (sum((((increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range))) or 0 * sum((((increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range)))) - (sum((((increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_cost_compared_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range))) or 0 * sum((((increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_cost_baseline_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",host_name=~"$host"} offset $__range))))

panels.title: Own and all
panels.description: Who sees what.

options.content:
**All usage.** Metrics carry no user or group, by design, so every Prometheus panel here shows the whole gateway to whoever can open Grafana. The per-user table reads `model.usage` logs and is an administrator view. Budgets are named by their administrator-chosen id; directory group names and budget subjects never leave the endpoint.

**Own usage.** A person sees only their own usage from the gateway (`defenseclaw routing usage`, `defenseclaw routing budgets list`, `GET /usage`). Group totals are administrator-only.

list.label: User regex
list.description: Regex over user.id (uid or SID), the account name or the directory principal (case-insensitive). Narrows every Loki panel on this board. Prometheus panels have no per-user label and stay fleet-wide.

title: DefenseClaw — Routing, Savings & Budgets
description: What the semantic router is doing and what it saves: routing decisions over time by result, reason, listener and model, fallbacks and refusals, spend against the counterfactual of sending every call to the model the client asked for, and budgets (spend against limit, stops, the fleet store). Variables narrow by connector, host, budget, group budget and user.
